lines.text: AWEFULLY miraculously
I created of God
All of me and all of my frame
I‘m wonderfully made.
When I’m in secret made and formed
My mortal frame Thou knew
My all and all is known to Thee
E’en though the soul is naught.
Worthy and great Thy thought oh Lord
Priceless assets be it
More in quantum than sea-shore sands
Numberless unto men.
So well my frame is known to Thee
My soul oh Lord to prove
Thy way reveal Lord unto me
My path guide, Lord I plead.
